title: GitHub Actions setup-java is pulling the Oracle JDK build
basis: Oracle No-Fee Terms and Conditions (NFTC) / Oracle Technology Network license

title: setup-java distribution graalvm is Oracle GraalVM, not the community build
basis: Oracle GraalVM Free Terms and Conditions (GFTC), same clock as the JDK it is built on

title: Java binary fetched straight from Oracle's download host
basis: Oracle No-Fee Terms and Conditions (NFTC) / Oracle Technology Network license

title: Script accepts the Oracle license header to get past the download gate
basis: Accepting Oracle Technology Network terms in automation binds the company that runs it
fix: drop the line and fetch an OpenJDK build that needs no license header

title: SDKMAN vendor suffix -oracle / -graal installs an Oracle-licensed build
basis: Oracle No-Fee Terms and Conditions (NFTC) / Oracle GraalVM Free Terms and Conditions

title: Container image comes from Oracle's own Java registry
basis: Oracle No-Fee Terms and Conditions (NFTC) attached to the image, not the Dockerfile

title: Oracle Linux package manager is installing the Oracle JDK rpm
basis: Oracle No-Fee Terms and Conditions (NFTC); the rpm carries the same terms as the tarball

title: Third-party installer package that downloads the Oracle JDK for you
basis: The installer accepts Oracle's terms on your behalf; the binary is still Oracle's

title: Build sets an environment variable that accepts the Oracle license
basis: An automated acceptance is still an acceptance of the Oracle Technology Network terms
fix: remove the variable and switch the base image to an OpenJDK build
